'''Taktos''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Utapau (star)/Legends|Utapau]] in the [[Utapau system/Legends|Utapau system]], located in the [[Tarabba sector/Legends|Tarabba sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Taktos was a [[Temperature/Legends|searing]] rock with four [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Utapau system/Legends|Utapau system]], except [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
